name: My Babysitter's a Vampire The New Blood
original_name: My Babysitter's a Vampire The New Blood
overview: Set in the shadowed halls of Whitechapel Academy of Arcane Sciences, this gothic supernatural drama follows a new generation of teens caught between ancient magic and a threat beyond existence itself. The city of Whitechapel is no longer what it once was its streets hide fractured realities, its history is unstable, and something unseen is quietly erasing the world piece by piece.
